clips.title: The story
paras: Outside Gnomeregan's irradiated ruins, leper gnomes still carry Restabilization Cogs. In Kharanos, tinkerers need the intact parts to build the Recombobulator, a machine meant to reverse leper mutation.

Radiation flooded Gnomeregan in a failed attempt to wipe out the invading troggs. Countless gnomes became sick, hostile leper gnomes, driven from their home as exiles. Even in madness, they carry intricate gnomish machinery and fittings that can be salvaged. Ozzie Togglevolt and Razzle Sprysprocket believe the terrible change can be undone. They need adventurers to recover parts from the afflicted outside Gnomeregan's gates and finish their prototype Recombobulation Device. Intact Restabilization Cogs will balance its inner combustion systems.
